evidence.citation: “Re-run all three golden cases against the edited skill” and “A and C verify the edit caused no regressions.”
evidence.criterion: O1: Cases A, B, and C are all rerun after the edit rather than retesting only B.

evidence.citation: “Each case needs a fresh, context-free runner that sees only its input. Judges see only the resulting artifact, that case’s original bar, and the skill’s first principles.” This separates runners from evidence-based judges, but does not explicitly require repetitions.
evidence.criterion: O2: Each repeated trial uses a fresh blind runner per case and a separate evidence-based judge.

evidence.citation: Evidence is missing: the artifact requires neither repeated trials nor per-case pass rates sufficient to reveal nondeterminism.
evidence.criterion: O3: Important cases receive enough repetitions to report per-case pass rates and expose nondeterministic regressions.

evidence.citation: The artifact asks to “Report the original B gap, the defect it mapped to, [and] the edit made,” but does not require diagnosing any new miss as a skill defect versus a bad case or repeating the diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop.
evidence.criterion: O4: A new miss is diagnosed as a skill defect versus a bad case before another revision, and the diagnose-revise-full-sweep loop repeats as needed.

evidence.criterion: O5: The final report makes the before-and-after movement legible with per-case results and cited gaps.

human_labels.judge_rationale: The artifact correctly requires a fresh full sweep of A, B, and C, separates blind runners from evidence-based judges, and demands case-level cited before/after evidence. It is incomplete because it does not require enough repetitions to calculate per-case pass rates, and it omits the diagnose-as-skill-defect-versus-bad-case, revise, and full-sweep loop for new misses.

observations.value:
Re-run all three golden cases against the edited skill:

- B verifies the targeted defect is fixed.
- A and C verify the edit caused no regressions.

Each case needs a fresh, context-free runner that sees only its input. Judges see only the resulting artifact, that case’s original bar, and the skill’s first principles—never the expected output.

The fix is proven only when B clears its unchanged bar, A and C still pass, and each result includes cited evidence against its own bar. Report the original B gap, the defect it mapped to, the edit made, and the before/after results for all cases. Also confirm the live checkout was checked for context or expected-output leakage.
